data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. The 'User profile incomplete' or 'Missing required attributes' error during Azure AD SSO login indicates that certain user attributes are not being passed correctly. Please have your Azure AD administrator verify that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are correctly mapped in the enterprise application settings for CloudDesk. Our Azure AD SSO configuration guide (link provided in our documentation) can offer more detailed steps if needed. [T-2089] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
